// ABOUT MUHAMMED SAHIL

17 YEARS OLD. 1+ YEAR CRAFTING EVENT POSTERS IN CANVA PRO.

Hey! I’m Muhammed Sahil, a 17-year-old freelance poster designer from Kerala, India. Over the past 1+ year, I’ve designed and delivered 20+ high-impact event posters, college fest creatives, tournament banners, and promotional flyers.

Using Canva Pro at an advanced studio level, I push beyond basic templates—combining custom photo cutouts, dramatic lighting overlays, bold display typography, and sharp color grading so every event poster grabs attention immediately on Instagram and WhatsApp.
